name: My AI
author: t1nk33r
description: Every AI surface in one bar mark and one tabbed panel: subscription limits and pace (Claude, Codex, Fireworks, OMP), spend analytics (codeburn), the Herdr/OMP connector fleet, the DeepSeek balance with its peak/off-peak schedule, and the OpenRouter credit balance and spend. Merges t1nk33r.codeburn, t1nk33r.fleet-shepherd and t1nk33r.deepseek (plan 128) into the former t1nk33r.agents (plan 090).

barWidget.description: One glyph, one badge, five tabs: Limits · Spend · Fleet · DeepSeek · OpenRouter.

schema.label: Bar badge
schema.description: The figure shown beside the glyph: fleet working count, DeepSeek balance, OpenRouter balance, current-period spend, or nothing.

schema.label: Tab on open
schema.description: The tab every opening of the panel lands on. IPC `tab`/`next` and a middle-click on the mark still open on the tab they ask for.

schema.label: Limits provider on open
schema.description: The Limits rail provider every opening selects. If it has no record yet, the first provider shows until it arrives; a provider picked while the panel is open stays picked.

schema.label: Synced aggregation
schema.description: When On, write this machine's local usage snapshot and merge snapshots from other machines.

schema.label: Spend: leave OMP out
schema.description: The Spend tab counts oh-my-pi's usage at API rates, an overview of what it would have cost. Turn on to take OMP off the totals, tokens, activities and providers instead.

schema.label: DeepSeek model for the token estimate
OpenRouter low balance (credits)
schema.description: The mark turns urgent when the OpenRouter balance is at or below this many credits (US dollars).
